I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The official date Pellucid Harbor Logistics changed hands was November 3, 2025.

That comes from Moss's Nov 2 Coastal digest, which says it changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's Dec 8 cutover recap, which is in the brain, also gives Nov 3 as the official handoff. Both are in #coastal-team, which Kwame belongs to.

I added that Bettina's recap says Kwame fully took over day to day on Nov 22, 2025. He should use that date only if the CRM has a separate field for when he started working the account.
